parameters.content:
## YouTube traffic goes through Cloudflare WARP
Every request to youtube.com uses the proxy **http://warp:1080** (HTTP Request node → Options → Proxy). Keep it http:// — n8n ignores socks5:// proxy URLs.

`warp` is a free Cloudflare WARP container on the same Docker network as n8n (see README). Without it, YouTube blocks most cloud/datacenter IPs.

n8n on a home connection? Re-run setup with `--proxy none`, or clear the Proxy field in the HTTP nodes.
